description: 3M Combo Liquid Wax and Microfiber Cloth - Distributed/Packaged by 3M. Product Details: Restores gloss to paint surfaces protects paint from UV rays safe on all paint finishes the premium liquid wax removes oxidation, cleans, polishes and protects all painted surfaces. It forms a super-slick, protective barrier between the car's paint and the environment, reducing the adhesion and build-up of mud, tar, insects and road grime. It gives higher post application glow compared to other brands. Clean the surface to remove any dirt apply the 3M premium liquid wax to a clean, dry microfiber cloth / sponge and spread it uniformly over the painted surface let the wax remain on the surface for 5-10 minutes wipe it off with a clean, dry microfiber cloth and polish it by hand to attain a high lustre.
